# Season statistics parity fixtures

Generated by `.agents/sos_port/season_stats_fixtures.py`; do not edit by hand. Each file is cut from
a published `nfl-sos-ratings` Parquet file (`data/...`, read at the checkout's commit
`9081bced89b0d51c99e28f80f8f62b9fcd0118e0`) or from the snapshot of nflreadpy's disk cache that
project's files were built from (`snapshot/...`, checked against its SHA-256 manifest).
`manifest.json` holds the same records with full hashes, and
`tests/test_season_stats_published_parity.py` checks every fixture against its hash. The SHA-256
columns show the first 12 characters.
